sections.heading: 1. Early care
lines: ① Take rings off early, before swelling.
② Keep it raised, cold pack 10–15 minutes.
③ Keep fingers, elbow and shoulder moving gently.
④ Avoid leaning or lifting on it for now.

sections.heading: 2. Get checked soon if…
lines: The thumb-base hollow is tender, or the
wrist changes shape — see a GP or ED.

caption:
Koko slipped on a wet deck and put a hand out. Days later, the wrist is still sore.

Throwing a hand out when you fall is instinctive. Many of these are sprains that settle, but some involve a small bone at the base of the thumb that can be easy to miss.

Tenderness in the hollow at the base of the thumb, swelling, a change in shape or trouble gripping are worth checking, often with an X-ray through your GP or emergency department. Once that's ruled out, rehab rebuilds movement and grip step by step.
